verdict.line: You lose if you let him sit on Burning Agony and poke with Infected Cleaver all day; you win if you force extended trades where his cleaver whiffs and your stun lands.

brief.thesis: Jax vs Dr. Mundo sits dead even at 45.1% over 306 games, with the whole lane built around one tempo mismatch: Mundo's Q (Infected Cleaver) is a 975-range, 4s-cooldown poke tool that punishes you for walking up, but it has to land, and once you're in his face his only sustained damage is W (Burning Agony) draining his own health. Your job is to eat or dodge the cleaver, then win the stand-still fight.

theirWindow.what: He throws Q (Infected Cleaver) for free max-health damage every 4 seconds if you're walking up or recalling minions. Don't approach in a straight line when it's up — angle through minions so it's eating creep, not you.

yourWindow.what: The instant his Q is down, walk up and commit. Use E (Counter Strike) to dodge his next few autos (including any Masochism-boosted ones) and land the stun, then W (Empower) into an auto and leap away with Q (Leap Strike) before his next cleaver comes off cooldown.

playing.title: Angle through creeps vs Q
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver (Q, 975 range, 4s cooldown) deals damage based on your max health, so never approach him in a straight line while it's up. Walk through your minion wave so it has to pick a target.

playing.title: Save E for his Masochism window
playing.detail: E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks and reduces AoE damage, then stuns. Hold it for when his E (Masochism) is active and his autos are buffed by missing-health AD — that's when dodging hits hardest.

playing.title: Commit only when his Q is down
playing.detail: Track his Infected Cleaver cooldown (4s) — if he just threw it, you have a free window to walk up, Leap Strike (Q) in, and trade before he can poke you again.

playing.title: Don't chase into Sadism
playing.detail: His R (Sadism) sacrifices health for massive movement speed and regen, letting him disengage or outheal your damage. Don't burn Leap Strike (Q) chasing a Mundo who just popped it — reset instead.

playing.title: Empower your leap-ins, not your pokes
playing.detail: W (Empower) adds bonus damage to your next attack or Leap Strike and hits nearby enemies — save the charge for the moment you commit to a stand-still fight, not for poking from max range where his cleaver still wins the trade.

playing.title: Reset waves before his cleaver timer
playing.detail: Since his main pressure tool is a 4s-cooldown ranged poke, you want short, frequent trades rather than long stand-offs at range — back off and crash the wave rather than soaking chip damage.

playing.title: Itemize lifesteal if the fight drags
playing.detail: His Adrenaline Rush passive regenerates a portion of max health every second, so if trades go long, prioritize Blade of The Ruined King's active and lifesteal over pure burst — you need sustained damage to outpace his regen, not one big hit.
